source.publication: 2025 Schedule M1R, Age 65 or Older/Disabled Subtraction
source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1R lines 1-13 and Line 10 table (M1R PDF p.1, p.2); Form M1 instructions PDF p.15; M1M PDF p.5 line 16; Schedule M1M line 25 (M1M PDF p.7 'Line 25 - Military Pension or Retirement Pay'); Form M1 instructions PDF p.26 'Military Pensions'; Schedule M1M line 1 (M1M PDF p.3 'Line 1 - Interest From Municipal Bonds of Another State')

worked: A military pension is not on M1R lines 4-6, so it leaves the 9,600 whole, though it counts in federal AGI. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 2,000.00 + pension 12,000.00 = 14,000.00. Federal taxable income = 14,000.00 - 17,750.00 federal standard deduction (15,750 plus 1 x 2,000) = below zero, so 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, single: line 1 federal AGI 14,000.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 30,000.00; line 10 additions 30,000.00; Form M1 line 2 30,000.00; line 3 = 44,000.00. Schedule M1R: line 1 9,600.00; line 2 0.00 (65 or older); line 3 9,600.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 nontaxable Social Security 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; line 6 Railroad Retirement Board benefits 0.00; line 7 0.00; line 8 = 9,600.00. Line 9 14,000.00; line 10 14,500.00; line 11 0.00; line 12 0.00; line 13 = 9,600.00. Schedule M1M line 25 military pension 12,000.00, included in federal AGI. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 9,600.00 + 0.00 + 12,000.00 = 21,600.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 44,000.00 - 21,600.00 = 22,400.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 14,950.00 plus 1 x 2,000 age box(es) = 16,950.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 16,950.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 16,950.00 + 21,600.00 = 38,550.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 44,000.00 - 38,550.00 = 5,450.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (5,450.00 - 0.00) = 291.575 = 291.575. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 292; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00; state income tax 291.58.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
